applicability.goal: Lift the free wrench at least 20 mm with no fixture or nut support for 2 continuous seconds. Use its head to turn the passive braked nut at least positive 45 degrees from its initial angle for 0.5 continuous seconds. Withdraw the head at least 30 mm clear of the nut while retaining the unsupported tool and the nut angle for 1 second. Keep at least two distinct hand parts contacting the tool. Never touch the nut directly with the robot.
